question: In two-player play, does House Hagal act after the second human’s Agent turns or after the first player Reveals, and how does a Swordmaster affect its number of turns?
key: Only after first-player Agent turns while Rival Agent remains;not after second human or Reveal. May3turns when first hasSwordmaster versus2 next round when first lacks,has3Agents.

observed.answer: Hagal acts after each First Player Agent turn, not after the second human’s turns or after a Reveal. It can take up to three turns per round; temporary Mentat or recalled Agents can increase the First Player’s Agent turns and early Revealing can reduce the number. Swordmaster availability affects turns through the First Player’s actual Agent turns, not a fixed two-turn schedule.
observed.evidence: House Hagal Agent turns: after each First Player Agent turn; no fixed two-turn limit; max three Rival turns.

question: How do you prepare the humans’ initial decks, the Imperium Row, the Intrigue deck, the Reserve, the Mentat and Alliance tokens, and the initial first player before Round 1?
key: Each human shuffles their own standard ten-card starting deck and places it face down. Shuffle the Imperium deck and deal five face up to the Row; shuffle Intrigues face down separately. Place Arrakis Liaison, The Spice Must Flow, and Foldspace as three separate Reserve stacks beside the Row. Put the Mentat at its Landsraad space and the four Alliances on their marked Influence-track areas. Randomly choose the initial first player and give that player the marker.

observed.answer: Set the board with Mentat on its side in its space and Alliance tokens on the Faction tracks. Build the Conflict deck in three separately shuffled tiers (1 Conflict I, 5 Conflict II, all 4 Conflict III), returning unused cards unseen. Shuffle Intrigue and Imperium decks; deal 5 Imperium cards face up for the Row; set out the three Reserve stacks. Each human chooses/takes a Leader and color, shuffles their 10-card starting deck, starts with 2 Agents and Swordmaster aside, and places score/combat markers and Influence cubes as specified. Set out 3 troops in garrison and 9 in supply, take 1 water, and form the resource bank. Randomly choose the first player and give them the marker; in two-player, also set up Hagal.
observed.evidence: Setup steps 1–9 describe these deck, board, token, player and first-player preparations.
